msContents.summary:
Sancta Sophai (Marsilius de)/de Pulsibus. ALBERTI (Bernardus). Super prima Fen quarti Canonis. JACOBUS de Prato. Scientia manuallis. Written by Bartholomaeus Cynthius de Pesaro. Written in double column of 31-33 lines to a column, in a narrow sloped semi-current humanistic hand. Large initial F in gold on a decorated blue ground on fol. 1, initial I in gold on fol. 121; initial in brouwn on fol. 151. Headings in red, with blank spaces for initials. The second work has signatures in red (A-C10).
[li]Sancta Sophia (M. de). De pulsibus. Fol. 1, col. 1 FEBRIVM Parti/cularibus horis arte puls/uum differencie correspond/ent... 115v, col. 2 ...comprehendere poteris tempo/ribus naturalibus ad particularia./Et in isto finiatur hoc opus de/pulsibus febrium pro quo omnipotenti Deo/gracias ago eiusque matri Beatissime Virgini/Marie quibus sit Laus et gloria/per Infinita seculaseculorum. amen.//(red ) Explicit Libellus de pulsibus/Febrium aeditum per famosisimum/marsilium. Scriptumquer omni/diligentia et Cura per Bartholo/meum Cynthium. scilicet. Pisaurensem/M. D. V. die 12a octobris/hora xxia Deo fauente. Ff. 116-120 Blank.[/li][li]Aberti (B.). Super prima Fen quarti Canonis. Fol. 121, col. 1 (red) INCLINATVS MVLTORVM VOCIBVS/ut super quarto canone receptas formarem.. 147, col. 1 ...Item ad idem aqua/aluminis destillata. etc. (red) Deo la ?us gratia et gratiarum actio. viuenti et/sananti semper. amen. col. 2 Aqua fructuum secundum Mesuem: and 3 other receipts. Ff. 148-150 Blank.[/li][li]Jacobus de Prato. Scientia manualis. Fol. 151, col. 1 (red) SCIENCIA MANVALIS./medicine agregatur [sic] ex regulis/quibus dirigitur... 176, col. 1 quae ponuntur in capitulo de medicins r[esoluen]/tubus usetigia ulcerum. et sic est [finis pri]/mi Libri etc.//(red) Laus Deo.[/li]
